name: Mallet
maturity: first-release-candidate; independent stranger and hosted acceptance pending
description: Owner-run repair shop management with customer and vehicle history, appointments, inspections, exact-revision approvals, technician work, parts, invoices and portable records. The contract distinguishes shipped behavior from planned capabilities.
nonGoals: Payments or automatic accounting posting/Xero import
Supplier ordering networks or stock mutations
Vehicle-registry lookups, OEM repair data or warranty claims
Automatic repair-estimate email delivery or customer signing portal
Importing historical repair jobs, invoices or authorisations
Erasure of assets with visits in the first release
A live run-site deploy, custom domain or additional provider integrations

deploy.notes: Native owner sessions guard /app; unknown paths return real 404s; development and demo mail is suppressed.
